sources.title: Determination of Zinc Contents in Iranian Flat Breads
sources.sampleDescription: 36 flatbread samples collected from Tehran bakeries in 2004; type-specific sample counts not stated in accessible abstract.
sources.methods: Flame atomic absorption spectrophotometry for zinc.
limitations: Reported in mg/kg; accessible abstract does not establish moisture/as-eaten basis
Type-specific sample counts unavailable in abstract

sources.title: Determination of metal(oids) in different traditional flat breads distributed in Isfahan city, Iran: Health risk assessment study by latin hypercube sampling
sources.sampleDescription: 93 fresh breads from Isfahan bakeries: Barbari 31, Taftoon 31, Lavash 31; no Sangak.
sources.methods: Samples oven-dried at 50°C for 48 hours, acid digestion, ICP-OES and AAS.
limitations: Study is focused on toxic element exposure risk, not food-composition profiling
Contains contaminant elements; do not import as nutrient values
